overview: First-term Democrat George Whitesides defends a Los Angeles-area district that leans Democratic by about six points. He enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised nearly $4 million to Republican Jason Gibbs's roughly $380,000, and with little outside money targeting the seat so far. Prediction markets give Whitesides about a 93% chance of winning. No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district lean, incumbency, and money. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with Whitesides favored by a wide but not overwhelming margin given the absence of direct polling.
